sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
[[Nimue Casterwill]] took the Huntik team here where [[Cherit]] was able to activate the lamps with his energy charge, creating the [[Dragon's Breath]]. The Huntik team then travelled in a [[deck boat]] from here to Avalon. {{source|Knight of the Willblade}}

full_text:
The Dragon's Cliffs is an ancient Casterwill family site on the coast of England. There is a large dragon sculpture carved into the cliff face, with two lamps which, when charged up, activates the Dragon's Breath, a blue mist trail that points the way to Avalon.

==History==
Nimue Casterwill took the Huntik team here where Cherit was able to activate the lamps with his energy charge, creating the Dragon's Breath. The Huntik team then travelled in a deck boat from here to Avalon. [Knight of the Willblade]

The '''Dragon's Cliffs''' is an ancient [[Casterwill family]] site on the coast of [[England]]. There is a large dragon sculpture carved into the cliff face, with two lamps which, when charged up, activates the [[Dragon's Breath]], a blue mist trail that points the way to [[Avalon]].

==History==
[[Nimue Casterwill]] took the Huntik team here where [[Cherit]] was able to activate the lamps with his energy charge, creating the [[Dragon's Breath]]. The Huntik team then travelled in a [[deck boat]] from here to Avalon. {{source|Knight of the Willblade}}
